dft_code.name: Open-source DFT package (Quantum ESPRESSO or equivalent)

access.notes: Any plane-wave DFT code that supports PBE, van der Waals corrections, CI-NEB, and charge density output is acceptable.

dft_code.notes: The solver must install and use one such package.

bader_tool.name: Bader charge analysis program (Henkelman group)

access.notes: Open-source program to partition electron density and compute net atomic charges.

bader_tool.notes: Must be compatible with the charge density output of the chosen DFT code.

mos2_structure.name: MoS2 monolayer structure and V_MoS6 pore definition

access.notes: Standard crystallographic data: space group P6̄m2, a ≈ 3.16 Å. The perfect unit cell can be obtained from Materials Project (mp-2815) or constructed from the lattice parameters. The V_MoS6 pore is manually introduced as described in the workflow steps.

mos2_structure.notes: No external file is required; the agent generates the coordinates.
